items.quote: 6:2 And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD
items.claim: God spoke to Moses and identified himself as 'the LORD'

items.quote: 6:3 And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty
items.claim: God appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob by the name 'God Almighty'
items.object: Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob
items.mechanism: by the name of God Almighty

items.quote: but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them
items.claim: God was not known to the patriarchs by the name 'JEHOVAH'
